thread:
Asha (Support): Customer (acme-inc) reports repeated 502s when calling hosted inference /v1/embeddings. spikes ~every 10s for ~2m, affects ~40% of requests in window :frowning:
Tom (Oncall): Can you paste a repro req (curl + headers) and a sample trace id? tagging @Kai to check edge side.
Asha (Support): Trace ids: 01H3XQ8Q2Z7YQ0ABCDEF1234, 01H3XQ8M5K2YQ0ABCDE9999. sample curl: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Tenant: acme-inc" \n  -H "X-Model: embed-small" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  --data '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Kai (Infra): Looking at frontdoor logs for that window I see a burst of upstream TLS errors + envoy upstream_reset, e.g.: ```
[2025-09-03T12:14:22Z] upstream_reset: reason=TLS handshake timeout code=502 upstream=midproxy-12
[2025-09-03T12:14:24Z] connection_pool: pending=192 active=64 max=1024
```
Kai (Infra): Also noticed a correlated SNI rotate event around 12:14:21 which caused midproxy to re-resolve upstreams for a subset of tenants. some in-flight connections got reset while the pool warmed.
infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled midproxy-pool from 3 -> 6 (policy: queued_conn>150) at 2025-09-03T12:14:25Z :rocket:
Derek (Eng): Hypothesis: small request payloads + TLS rehandshake are triggering Nagle-like packet coalescing + delayed ack behavior on our path, increasing time-to-first-bytes and causing Envoy to consider upstream as failed during the SNI switch. weird combo but plausible with high concurrency.
Tom (Oncall): Can you share a quick reproduce command we can run from our lab to hit the same codepath?
Kai (Infra): Repro (from lab): ```
# simulate tenant routing + SNI resolution pressure
h2load -n 5000 -c 50 -m 10 --h1 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'X-Tenant: acme-inc' -H 'X-Model: embed-small'
# or wrk: wrk -t10 -c50 -d30s -s scripts/large-header.lua https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
Kai (Infra): Observed: when concurrency >40 and we toggle SNI entries (simulate rotation), 502 spike reproduces locally.
Derek (Eng): Short-term mitigation: pin acme-inc to fallback route (no SNI rotate) and increase envoy upstream idle/handshake timeouts to 30s for that tenant. Long-term: make midproxy SNI rollout drain without dropping in-flight TLS sessions (keep upstream stickiness + gradual swap).
Tom (Oncall): Applied tenant pin + bumped upstream handshake timeout for acme-inc. rolling monitor now. Notified customer and CS.
Asha (Support): Customer acked — error rate dropped to baseline after fallback, they reported fewer 502s. will schedule RCA write-up and add test to our chaos lab to avoid regressions. :white_check_mark:
